Photo 1: The same table outdoors, showing its full structure. The top and shelves have a white marble-like finish. The yellow metal frame has vertical bars. The table is positioned on a concrete surface in front of a black gate.

Photo 2: A side view of the table outdoors, showing the top and one lower shelf. The marble pattern is visible, and the yellow frame is consistent. The surface appears slightly worn with some scuff marks and minor chips on the edges of the top.
No brand or model is visible on any surface of the table.
